data.title: Trump’s U-Turn on Iran Sanctions Would Unravel Decades of Curbs
data.description: The Trump administration’s effort to unwind decades of sanctions as part of a deal to end the war with Iran has created a head-spinning situation for governments, banks and other companies as they contemplate a shifting patchwork of new permissions and old restrictions.
